trace.detail:
MESSAGE:
Dear Team at Acme Cloud Services,

Thank you for your email regarding renewal of our services agreement for a further 12 months. We value our partnership and are open to renewal, but we are unable to accept the proposed 12% increase.

Under Clause 8.2 of our agreement, renewal price increases are capped at 7% unless both parties agree otherwise in writing. A 12% increase exceeds this cap and, per our internal procurement policy, increases above 10% cannot be accepted as proposed and must either be negotiated down or opened to competitive bidding. We are prepared to discuss an increase within the 7% cap under Clause 8.2, or a higher figure only with detailed written justification for the rising infrastructure costs referenced in your email.

Separately, per Clause 4.1, the agreed uptime SLA is 99.9% monthly. Our records show shortfalls in May (99.42%) and July (99.61%), triggering service credits under Clause 4.2 (5% of monthly fee per month below target). This results in a total credit of Rs 20,000, which has not yet been claimed and must be applied before renewal proceeds.

We also note invoice INV-2609-07 (Rs 2,00,000, due 30 September) remains pending; kindly confirm its status.

We would appreciate your written justification for the proposed increase, and confirmation of the Rs 20,000 SLA credit, so we can proceed with renewal discussions under Clause 8.1.

We look forward to your prompt response.

Kind regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement
